titulo: Major repairs needed to save Horseshoe Bay Lagoon
cuerpo: Volunteer researcher Chris Hopper, JCU's adjunct professor Eric Wolanski and independent researcher Natalie K. Dowling examined the impact of saltwater and erosion on Horseshoe Bay Lagoon, a freshwater lagoon and one of the few swamps with bulkuru sedge—also known as water chestnut—on the Magnetic Island (Yunbenun). The study is published in the journal Applied Sciences.
